review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Network Operations (BAU) Administer, configure and support the client network across Cisco and HP Aruba switching and wireless. VPN configuration and troubleshooting. Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth. Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards,
